description: Read current call readiness and persisted private-test proof for one accessible business. Only a currently entitled owner with a coherent assigned number gets the existing private-test setup link. Missing entitlement, incomplete setup or stale sessions do not authorize a call. It cannot assert or advance proof. A completed private test is separate from customer-route coverage; forwarding is optional and does not define whether the assigned phone works.

activation_session_id.description: Optional exact session ID. A superseded or foreign session is rejected.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token reaches exactly one business).

oauth_transaction_id.description: Opaque OAuth transaction identifier used only to bind a completed receipt.

origin_conversation_id.description: Opaque client conversation identifier used only to bind a completed receipt.

receipt_idempotency_key.description: Client key for replay-safe delivery of a completed activation receipt.

name: get_activation_status

owner_phone_on_file.description: Whether the owner's own mobile number is on file for SMS alerts or ring-first. Its absence does not invalidate an email-confirmed private test or require forwarding.

title: Get Activation Status
